decisions.reason: After four years and no observed website presence since 2019, this niche plugin likely fell below aspiration as a standalone offer, so we would reallocate its modest resources to core shop optimization work.

Even with weak external visibility, the ERP interface remains strategically important for end-to-end and multichannel ecommerce, so a growing firm with some slack would tend to retain it unless internal results were clearly poor.

Given the earlier pruning of a similar plugin and no later website evidence, this overlapping tracking plugin likely underperformed relative to aspirations and is a natural candidate for consolidation.
As another near-duplicate tracking plugin that never reappeared publicly, it would likely be dropped in a problemistic search to focus development on stronger or newer offerings.

This reporting plugin is adjacent to the core business but seems too peripheral and weakly evidenced after several years to justify continued attention versus established services and new development.
